hooks.command: loaded_root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; plugin_data="${PLUGIN_DATA:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-}}"; runtime_root="$loaded_root"; case "$loaded_root" in */plugins/cache/*/*/*) version="${loaded_root##*/}"; retained_base="$plugin_data/.runtime/hooks"; retained_link="$retained_base/by-version/$version"; if [ -x "$retained_link/hooks/occupancy.sh" ]; then runtime_root="$retained_link"; else source_root="$loaded_root"; if [ ! -x "$source_root/hooks/occupancy.sh" ]; then plugin_base="${loaded_root%/*}"; source_root=""; source_count=0; for candidate in "$plugin_base"/*; do if [ -d "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate/hooks/occupancy.sh" ]; then source_root="$candidate"; source_count=$((source_count + 1)); fi; done; [ "$source_count" -eq 1 ] || source_root=""; fi; if [ -n "$source_root" ] && [ -n "$plugin_data" ]; then original_umask="$(umask)"; umask 077; mkdir -p "$retained_base/snapshots" "$retained_base/by-version"; if [ -L "$retained_link" ] && [ ! -e "$retained_link" ]; then rm -f "$retained_link"; fi; stage="$(mktemp -d "$retained_base/snapshots/$version.XXXXXX")" || stage=""; published=0; source_version="${source_root##*/}"; if [ -n "$stage" ] && cp -R "$source_root/." "$stage" && printf '%s\n' "$source_version" > "$stage/.circus-source-version" && [ -x "$stage/hooks/occupancy.sh" ] && ln -sn "../snapshots/${stage##*/}" "$retained_link" 2>/dev/null; then published=1; fi; if [ -x "$retained_link/hooks/occupancy.sh" ]; then runtime_root="$retained_link"; else runtime_root="$source_root"; fi; if [ -n "$stage" ] && [ "$published" -eq 0 ]; then rm -rf "$stage"; fi; umask "$original_umask"; else runtime_root="$source_root"; fi; fi ;; esac; hook_entry="$runtime_root/hooks/occupancy.sh"; export PLUGIN_ROOT="$runtime_root" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$runtime_root"; if [ ! -x "$hook_entry" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'dibs PreToolUse hook has no retained or active runtime; restart this Codex session.' >&2; exit 2; fi; "$hook_entry"
